data.title: Notice about Heating Cost Meter Reading and Smoke Detector Maintenance
data.summary: The property management company (Hausverwaltung Muster & Partner) informs the tenant of Lindenweg 12, WE 3 that the heating cost allocators (Heizkostenverteiler) will be read and smoke detectors (Rauchwarnmelder) serviced in January, proposing 12.01., 14.01. or 16.01.2026 between 8 and 12 o'clock. The tenant is asked to confirm within 7 working days of the letter's date which proposed appointment allows access to the apartment.
data.explanation: Your property manager needs access to your apartment in January to read the heating cost meters and check the smoke detectors, and offers you three possible dates. You are asked to reply by the deadline shown, telling them which of the three dates (12, 14 or 16 January 2026, morning) works for you. This is a practical scheduling request, not a formal legal deadline, but replying promptly avoids follow-up letters or a missed appointment. No payment is requested in this letter.
